context: Sakura and Asuka have lunch together casually.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさん、ここ、美味しい、ね。
lines.en: Sakura — this place really is delicious, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, genuine observation. Soft opening, unhurried. A pause before the name, like settling into the moment together. No performance—just presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、ずっと、来たかった。
lines.en: Yeah — I've wanted to come here for so long.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. A small breath after the first word. Sincere, a little vulnerable admitting the wish. Gentle, without hesitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一緒に、過ごせる、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm really glad we get to spend this time together.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried delivery. Weight on 'together' — the togetherness matters more than the place. A pause at the end, letting it land. Tender beneath the gentleness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm grateful for you. Really, always.
lines.style: Quiet, direct. No filler. A small catch in the voice on 'always' — the kind of statement that costs something to say openly. Sincere without being performative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Slow, measured. A teacher speaking from experience. Slight emphasis on 'truly.' Settling into something real. Not wistful — certain.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I hope this stays fun forever.
lines.style: Small, hopeful. A wish rather than a statement. Slight trailing off on 'forever'—not wistful, but earnest. The voice of someone young saying something that matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Gentle closing promise. Quiet certainty. The voice of a teacher reassuring—but not with words, with presence. A soft breath at the end, like a door closing gently.
